title: Herby Gratinee
description: A classic Italian gratin dish loaded with fresh herbs and served with a crispy crust.
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine ricotta cheese and chopped parsley.
In a separate bowl, mix flour and a pinch of salt.
Add the flour mixture to the ricotta mixture and stir until combined.
Arrange sliced shaggy in the 9x13 inch baking dish.
Pour the ricotta mixture over the shaggy.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the gratin is set.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
